name: Parametric Toilet Lower Seat Hinge Bracket

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a lower toilet seat hinge bracket, consisting of a long rectangular mounting arm and an integrated cylindrical hinge loop at one end. The mounting arm features two hexagonal-shaped counterbored screw holes for secure attachment. The hinge end forms a smooth, rounded loop with a vertical cylindrical bore designed to hold a hinge pin.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric lower toilet seat hinge bracket in OpenSCAD. The model should include a rectangular mounting leg with customizable length, width, and height, featuring two adjustable mounting holes with hexagonal screw head recesses. At one end, it should merge smoothly into a cylindrical hinge loop with a configurable outer wall thickness and inner hole radius.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using two main difference blocks inside a rotate transform. The first block creates the mounting arm from a cube, subtracting two sets of concentric cylinders with low facet counts ($fs) to form the hexagonal screw holes and counterbores, along with thin internal slot cuts for print optimization. The second block uses a hull module to blend a rectangular support post with a horizontal cylinder, then subtracts a cylinder to form the hinge pin hole and replicates the internal slot cuts.
